cases.explain: The transitive verb возглавляет (presides over) requires the accusative case.
The verb произносит (pronounces) takes the accusative case for its direct object.
The noun дело (cause) in genitive with the meaning 'of the weak' requires the genitive adjective.
The verb явите (show) requires the dative case for the indirect object бедному.
The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.
The preposition во (in) with location requires the prepositional case.
The genitive земли shows possession: 'of the earth'.

cases.sentence: Суди ___, потому что ты наследуешь все народы.
cases.explain: The transitive verb суди (judge) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

reading.ru: Бог возглавляет великое собрание, среди богов произносит суд.
reading.question: What does God do in the great assembly?
options: He presides and pronounces judgment among the gods
He destroys the assembly with fire
He commands the gods to worship him
He removes the gods from their positions
reading.correct: He presides and pronounces judgment among the gods
reading.explain: The text states God 'возглавляет великое собрание' (presides over the great assembly) and 'произносит суд' (pronounces judgment).

reading.ru: Защищайте дело слабого и сироты, угнетенному и бедному явите справедливость.
reading.question: Who should be protected according to this verse?
options: The weak, the fatherless, the oppressed, and the poor
reading.correct: The weak, the fatherless, the oppressed, and the poor
reading.explain: The verse mentions защищайте дело слабого и сироты, угнетенному и бедному явите справедливость (defend the weak and orphans, show justice to the oppressed and poor).

reading.ru: Их знание ничто, их понимание бессмысленно.
reading.question: What is said about the wicked's knowledge and understanding?
options: Their knowledge is nothing and understanding is meaningless
They have great wisdom and deep understanding
They lead with intelligence and insight
reading.correct: Their knowledge is nothing and understanding is meaningless
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Их знание ничто, их понимание бессмысленно' (Their knowledge is nothing, their understanding is meaningless).

reading.ru: Я сказал, вы боги». Все вы сыны Всевышнего, но вы умрете, как все люди.
reading.question: What is the paradox presented in this verse?
options: Though called gods and sons of the Most High, they will die like ordinary people
The gods will never die and will live forever
People are immortal and will never face death
Only the sons of God die, but others live forever
reading.correct: Though called gods and sons of the Most High, they will die like ordinary people
reading.explain: The verse shows the paradox: despite being 'боги' (gods) and 'сыны Всевышнего' (sons of the Most High), 'вы умрете, как все люди' (you will die like all people).

reading.ru: Восстань, Боже, и суди землю, потому что ты наследуешь все народы.
reading.question: What is God asked to do and why?
options: To rise and judge the earth because he inherits all nations
To create new nations and destroy the old ones
To abandon the earth and live in heaven
To share his power with all the rulers
reading.correct: To rise and judge the earth because he inherits all nations
reading.explain: The psalm calls 'Восстань, Боже, и суди землю' (Rise, God, and judge the earth) with reason 'потому что ты наследуешь все народы' (because you inherit all nations).

reading.ru: Как долго еще вы будете судить несправедливо и оказывать предпочтение нечестивым?
reading.question: What accusations are made against the judges?
options: They judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked
They judge fairly and help the righteous
reading.correct: They judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked
reading.explain: The verse asks 'судить несправедливо и оказывать предпочтение нечестивым' (judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked).
